$comment: Machine-readable agent-harness config for Świetlik. One definition of 'the gate', shared by hooks, slash commands, subagents and CI, so a skill can never invent its own weaker sequence. Modelled on open-mercato's .ai/agentic.config.json.

validation.comment: Ordered, CI-mirroring gate. Run the smallest relevant prefix; run all of it before claiming a change is done. npm run lint (without :ci) is NOT in this list on purpose - it mutates source.

gates.comment: Which gate must be green before concluding, per changed path. Evaluated by .claude/hooks/gate-evidence.mjs.

instructionBudget.comment: Bytes. Agents load root instruction files first and truncate silently past their budget. 32768 is Codex's project_doc_max_bytes default; keep a reserve so future nested files still land.

untestable.comment: Known-uncovered surfaces. A change confined to these CANNOT be evidenced by npm run test:run - it needs docs/swietlik/verification.md instead.
